channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump's $2 billion midterms health-care payment reaches 20.8 million Americans
item.description: Medicare Advantage enrollees and millions of low-income recipients are excluded from the one-time payments, which will cost about $2 billion.

item.title: Four tribes partner with Kalshi to launch prediction apps
item.description: For tribes left out of the $46 billion casino boom, a disputed industry offers a different path.

item.title: Ozempic and Wegovy linked to lower Alzheimer's risk, study says
item.description: A new study reveals that the active ingredient in drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy could lower the risk of developing Alzheimer's disease.

item.title: FBI stops radicalized man after undercover sting over planned Mall of America attack
item.description: Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, 18, was investigated for nearly two years before paying an undercover FBI employee $600 for a rifle.
